plan.title: Alan Turing: The Man Who Taught Machines to Think
plan.description: A quick look at Alan Turing, the mathematician who helped break wartime codes and imagined thinking machines. His ideas still shape every computer we use today.

beats.narration: Your phone exists partly because one man asked a strange question: can a machine think? His name was Alan Turing.
He was a brilliant British mathematician. During World War Two, he helped crack secret enemy codes, work that helped save countless lives.
He also described the idea of a universal computer, and proposed a test for machine intelligence. Today, we still call it the Turing test.
